translation: Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Shilongchu [石龍芻], flavor bitter, slightly cold. It mainly treats evil qi of the heart and abdomen, difficult urination, strangury and urinary obstruction with wind-damp, and ghost zhu [鬼注] and evil poison. Taken over a long time, it supplements deficiency and emaciation and lightens the body
